items.label: MA-AG civil: Consumer Health Benefit Association and National Benefits Consultants, LLC
items.detail: Suffolk Superior Court judgment against two companies for marketing a discount health plan as health insurance; date is the announcement date. The release headlines $2.4 million; amount is the sum of its parts, $586,960.95 restitution plus $1,780,000 civil penalties plus $99,000 attorneys' fees, rounded to the dollar. Both defendants are ordered to pay jointly and are in bankruptcy, which affects collection. | One total paid by entities of this one company: counted once, in full, $2,465,961 (data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
